retrievalProfile.description: A close-up male portrait with soft outdoor bokeh and distressed stencil-style typography for a rustic country music aesthetic.
excludeWhen: urban or industrial backgrounds are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a young man in a blue henley shirt, positioned slightly off-center against a lush, blurred green background. The composition is anchored by bold, distressed white stencil lettering across the chest area, with secondary orange text stacked vertically on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed at the viewer to establish connection
Typography layered over the subject's torso to integrate text and image
Warm skin tones contrasting against cool blue clothing and green foliage
Distressed texture in font echoing a rustic, down-to-earth theme
coreInvariants: Distressed stencil-cut typography for the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white stencil text across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the large white text, then to the orange vertical text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Softly blurred foliage on the left side provides breathing room for secondary text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (primary text) for maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange (secondary text) to provide a warm pop.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Natural, medium saturation with soft, diffused lighting.

letterConstructionRules: Stencil-style gaps in vertical and horizontal strokes
Rough, eroded edges to simulate weathered paint
Uniform stroke weight for the primary display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: S and C characters feature distinct horizontal stencil breaks
M and R have industrial, blocky joints
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a large, distressed white stencil and a small, clean orange sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the industrial stencil gaps and slab-serif influence.
Provides the heavy, military-style stencil look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium close-up portrait of a young man with short brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a blue henley shirt and a cross necklace, set against a soft-focus green outdoor background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, distressed white stencil-style uppercase text across the chest area. Add a secondary stack of small, orange, wide-tracked uppercase sans-serif text in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Ensure the stencil gaps are visible in the primary text
Check that the orange text is vertically stacked and left-aligned
Verify the background bokeh is soft and natural
Confirm the distressed texture is applied to the white lettering

adjustableVariables: Level of distress on the typography
Accent color for the secondary text
mustRedesign: Avoid using clean, non-distressed fonts for the main title
Do not use high-contrast fashion lighting
postGenerationChecks: Is the primary text centered over the subject's chest?
Does the orange text have wide tracking?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to separate the subject?
Are the stencil breaks consistent across the main title?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a naturalistic male portrait with heavy, distressed stencil typography and a secondary vertical accent color text block.
